name: What interior remodel questions are best for a design-build firm?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a design-build company for an interior remodel so I know they can handle both design and construction?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a design-build company for an interior remodel so I know they can handle both design and construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a design-build firm, the most useful questions focus on integration. Ask who leads design decisions, how estimates are created from drawings, how revisions affect price, and how the team handles permitting and inspections. You should also ask how selections are tracked, how communication works between designer and builder, and whether the same team stays involved through construction. A good design-build company reduces gaps between vision and execution because the people designing the space understand how it will be built. That can save time and help avoid costly mismatches between plans and field conditions. The best firms are transparent about assumptions, allowances, and potential change-order triggers before work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how the team manages design, estimating, budgeting, permitting, selections, and construction under one process. A strong design-build firm should explain how decisions move from concept to pricing to build, and how they control changes once construction starts. The key is whether design intent and construction reality are coordinated from the beginning.
